name: scm-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol server for managing Palo Alto Networks Strata Cloud Manager firewall configurations through natural language in Claude. It provides 149 tools covering the full configuration lifecycle including policy objects, security rules, NAT, and profiles with multi-tenant support.
